Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy applies to NexusTransferPay, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

ApplicationNexusTransferPay
iOS bundle idcom.americangroupllc.nexuspay
Android packagecom.americangroupllc.nexuspay
DeveloperAmerican Group LLC
Contactcontact@safecodeg.com

Accounts

The app does not create accounts. Face ID, Touch ID or Android biometrics unlock data that is stored only on your device; biometric data itself never leaves the operating system and is never seen by the app or by us.

Device permissions

The app asks for the following permissions only when you use the related feature, and each request explains its purpose with the text below. You can decline any of them and keep using the rest of the app.

  • Camera — NexusPay needs camera access to verify your identity during KYC (capturing your ID document and selfie).
  • Face ID — NexusPay uses Face ID to securely authenticate you and authorize transfers.
  • Microphone — NexusPay may use the microphone for AI assistant voice features (optional).
  • Photo library — NexusPay needs photo library access to upload identity documents during KYC.

Android permissions declared: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, CAMERA, INTERNET, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, USE_BIOMETRIC, USE_FINGERPRINT.

Advertising

The app does not show advertisements and does not include an advertising SDK.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

This release sends no analytics and no crash reports to us. If a future version enables crash reporting, this page will be updated first.

Network

The app connects to the internet to provide its features. Connections use HTTPS.

Data retention and deletion

Data the app stores lives on your device and is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@safecodeg.com. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
